title: ConcatSourceInfo
description:
Chapters and global metadata from one source probe, read without changing the draft.

Both read-only sheets share this document so opening the second sheet does not start
a second media process.

chapters.description: Chapters in source order. Empty when the probe failed or the source has none.

chapters_detail.description: Why the chapter list is empty, or how many chapters it carries.

metadata.description: Global tags in source order. Empty when the probe failed or the file carries none.

metadata_detail.description: Why the metadata list is empty, or how many fields it carries.

ConcatChapter.description: One chapter the source reports, as a read-only convenience beside the copy setting.

end_seconds.description: End time in seconds when the probe reports one.

index.description: Zero-based position in the source's chapter list.

title.description: Chapter title when the source records one.

ConcatMetadataEntry.description: One global metadata tag the source reports, shown beside the copy setting.

key.description: Tag name exactly as FFmpeg prints it.

value.description: Tag value exactly as FFmpeg prints it.
